connect.title: Connect to Odoo
connect.description: In Odoo, open dooprint › Devices and click Connect to copy the pairing token.
connect.name: Name of this device
connect.nameHint: It will show up in Odoo with this name.
connect.tokenHint: Paste the whole string shown by Odoo: it already includes its address.

mode.agentHint: This device picks up its jobs from Odoo. Works with Odoo outside this network, with no ports to open.
mode.localHint: Odoo sends the job to this device. Only if Odoo is on this same network.

status.agentSummary: This device picks up its jobs from Odoo and prints them as they arrive.
status.localSummary: Odoo sends the jobs to this device, which must be on its same network.

unpair.title: Unpair
unpair.description: The device will stop receiving jobs from this Odoo.
